findings.title: Station reference changes escape publication freshness checks
findings.observedBehavior: An isolated +10 degree mutation of the retained CSPICE reference makes a fresh source comparison fail while publication --check still exits 0 with 42 verified, 22 uncertain and 0 failing claims.
findings.rootCause: The result receipts and observer archives are bound, but public/data/engineering-evidence/spice-reference.json is neither bound nor covered by the registered asset inventory.
reproducibleSteps: Create a disposable relative-path copy of compiler, binding, bound files, registered assets, both published JSON registers, CSPICE reference and scientific-audit/resources/sources. Do not modify the checkout or rebind receipts.

Run the original checkout's tsx and scripts/audit-resources-compare.ts with the scratch copy as cwd; confirm 288 comparisons pass. Run python3 scripts/compile-scientific-verification.py --check there; confirm exit 0.
Repeat the comparison: exit 1, Goldstone first-epoch azimuth error 10.000078898683 degrees versus tolerance 0.002. Repeat publication --check: exit 0, unchanged 42/22/0.
Repeat the publication mutation on an isolated exact 913d9d4 snapshot: exit 0, unchanged 41/21/0, establishing inherited lineage.
findings.recommendedChange: Bind actual comparison reference and implementation dependencies; add a reference-drift rejection regression without regenerating or restamping evidence to bypass failure.
findings.changeTestEvidence: No production fix made. Both endpoint controls and mutations executed in disposable copies. Fresh untouched resource and CLPS checks pass.
findings.limitations: A publication integrity gap, not evidence of corrupt current science or an operational qualification requirement. Inherited from the review base.

cameraReview.knownIssue: Plain canvas pointer-down cancels asset travel at the reviewed endpoint; isolated patch addresses this and related focus-request paths.
